title: Correctness of a Cell Block
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $\ell$ be a list of bit sources, and let $T,N$ be the parameters determining the tableau layout. For a binary input $w$, a block sequence, time $t\le T$, tape $\tau$, and cell index $r<2T+1$, suppose that every block whose index is strictly less than the index assigned to cell $(t,\tau,r)$ equals the expected tableau block at that index. Then evaluating the padded local source list for this cell against the input and blocks, and applying the cell update rule, yields exactly the expected encoding of cell $(t,\tau,r)$.
hypotheses_covered: Every block at index strictly before the target cell index equals its expected tableau block
